value.body: Sociology as a major studies society and social groups — caste, class, gender, family, religion, rural and urban life — along with classical and Indian sociological thought and social research methods such as surveys and fieldwork.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream. Central and many other universities admit through CUET-UG, where the subject itself can be one of the tests counted; others admit on Class 12 marks or their own test. Some universities fix the major at admission; others, under the NEP four-year programme, let students settle it after the first year.

value.title: At a glance
items: Fieldwork and survey methods are part of many courses.
Graduates work in NGOs and development projects, CSR, social and market research, HR and journalism.
Sociology is offered as an optional subject in the UPSC civil-services exam.
Common next steps: an M.A. Sociology, an MSW, development studies, or an MBA in HR.
